channel.title: Music in Africa - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Music in Africa (musicinafrica.net)

item.title: Open call: Composition Award for women composers in Sweden
item.description: Allmänna Sången in Sweden has announced that submissions for the next Allmänna Sången & Anders Wall Composition Award (ASAWCA) will open in March, ahead of the award presentation in spring 2027.

item.title: Menzi Music stays rooted in tradition on thoughtful Unamagqubu album
item.description: Menzi Music released his maskandi album Unamagqubu on 12 December 2025 through Menzi Music Production. Rooted in traditional guitar-driven arrangements and narrative-led songwriting, the album presents a focused exploration of personal experience and cultural identity within contemporary maskandi.

item.title: Open call: National Arts Council support funding programme in SA
item.description: The National Arts Council (NAC) of South Africa has opened applications for its three-year Arts Organisation Support Funding, inviting registered arts organisations and companies to apply for sustained financial support.

item.title: Nigerian music executive Bugwu Aneto-Okeke joins global Merlin board
item.description: Merlin, the global digital music licensing partner for independent labels and distributors, has announced its 2026 Board, bringing together leaders from 12 countries across Africa, Asia, Europe, Latin America, North America, and Oceania.

item.title: Calum Scott returns to SA with Avenoir tour as Cape Town show sells out
item.description: British singer and songwriter Calum Scott has returned to South Africa as part of his global Avenoir Tour, with performances scheduled in Cape Town, Durban and Pretoria.

item.title: Universal Music Group appoints Hannah Poferl as chief data officer
item.description: Universal Music Group (UMG) has appointed Hannah Poferl as its chief data officer, with immediate effect. She will be based in Santa Monica and report to the company’s chief operating officer, Boyd Muir.

item.title: Open call: Erasmus+ 2026 funding opportunities
item.description: The European Commission has launched the 2026 Erasmus+ Call for Proposals, opening access to funding for organisations and institutions involved in education, training, youth and sport. The programme supports learning mobility, international cooperation and capacity building within Europe and beyond.

item.title: Open call: 2026 UNESCO funding
item.description: UNESCO is inviting national authorities and civil society organisations to submit proposals aimed at strengthening the status of artists and promoting artistic freedom, in line with the 2005 Convention on the Protection and Promotion of the Diversity of Cultural Expressions.

item.title: Open call: Thought pieces on cultural exchange
item.description: The Goethe-Institut has issued an open call for proposals inviting contributions that critically examine the concept of ‘cultural exchange’, with a particular focus on its use within Africa–Europe cultural cooperation.

item.title: Tanzania: Abigail Chams drops Your Loss single, announces Visa partnership
item.description: Tanzanian artist Abigail Chams has released her first single of the year, ‘Your Loss’, accompanied by an official music video and the announcement of a new partnership with Visa.
